_comment: Public labels for the per-generator keys in the model metadata. Lives in models/, which the public snapshot excludes, because the keys are the generator names withheld from public documentation (June 2026 copyright sweep). scripts/build_model_card_assets.py refuses to run if a key has no label here. Labels match docs/calibration/univfd-v10onnx-divergence-fix.md.
